note: Synthetic conversation states. No real prospect data. Each case fixes the behaviour the operator asked for by name.

cases.name: he already said he's open to opportunities
messages: Would you be open to hearing more about it?
Yeah I'm always open to opportunities.

cases.name: he's down to hear it out
cases.why: Openness answered in different words still closes the topic
messages: Worth me explaining what we actually do?
go on, I'm down to hear it out

cases.name: podcast confusion outranks everything
cases.why: A wrong premise must be corrected before anything else happens
messages: Saw your work — would you be open to getting in front of more people?
how long is the pod and which show is it for?

cases.name: a pricing question is a buying question, not confusion
cases.why: Task 8: 'how much do you charge' was being treated as podcast confusion
messages: We handle placement across podcasts and written media for clients.
How much do you guys charge?

cases.name: a cost question before we explained anything needs clarity, not correction
cases.why: Task 8: the softer state — they hold no wrong premise
messages: Saw your work, wanted to reach out.

cases.name: an uninformed brush-off gets one clarification
cases.why: They declined a vague approach, not the offer
messages: Hey, saw your clinic — mind if I share something?

cases.name: an informed rejection is respected
cases.why: Pushing after a real no makes us a persistence bot
messages: We work with clients on written media and search presence.
so you work with your clients on the search side too?

cases.name: a deferral is timing, not rejection
cases.why: A live lead with bad timing must not be argued with
messages: Worth a look at what that would involve?
not right now, circle back next quarter

cases.name: build more value, no call yet
cases.why: Operator rejection: 'build more value, no call yet'
messages: I'm launching a supplement brand in Q1
What comes up when someone looks you up?
honestly not much, no press at all

cases.name: he doesn't seem like the money hungry type
cases.why: Operator rejection: money framing at a mission-driven prospect
messages: What's the main focus at the moment?
honestly I'm mainly trying to educate more patients properly

cases.name: a slot has been picked, so ask for the email and nothing else
cases.why: Booking is a sequence; re-proposing the call loses it
messages: Does Tuesday or Thursday work better?
